Short title and commencement

ACT XIII OF 2018
ACT XIII OF 2018
BALOCHISTAN ARTS COUNCIL ACT, 2018
An Act to provide for the establishment of the
Balochistan Arts Council to promote the Art and
Craft
of the people of Balochistan
[Gazette of Balochistan Extraordinary,
19th June, 2018]
No. PAB/Legis: V(24)/2018/1332,
dated 19.6.2018.---The Balochistan
Arts Council Bill (Bill No.24 of 2018) having been passed by the Provincial
Assembly of Balochistan on 28th May, 2018 and assented to by the Governor
Balochistan, on 13th June, 2018 is hereby published as an Act of the
Balochistan Provincial Assembly.
Preamble.---Whereas, it is expedient to provide for the
establishment of the Balochistan Art Council for patronage, promotion and
development of art and craft in Balochistan and matters connected or ancillary
thereto;
It is hereby enacted as follows:-
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Act may be called the Balochistan Arts Council Act, 2018.
(2) It
extends to the whole of Balochistan except the Tribal Areas.
(3) It
shall come into force at once.

Definitions

Balochistan Provincial Assembly.
Preamble.---Whereas, it is expedient to provide for the
establishment of the Balochistan Art Council for patronage, promotion and
development of art and craft in Balochistan and matters connected or ancillary
thereto;
It is hereby enacted as follows:-
2. Definitions.---In this Act, unless there is anything repugnant
in the subject or context ,-
(a) "Act"
means the Balochistan Arts Council Act, 2018;
(b) "Board"
means the Board of Governors of the Balochistan Art Council, as constituted
under section 8;
(c) "Chairperson"
means the Chairperson of the Board and includes a person deputed by the Chief
Minister to perform the functions of the Chairperson when the Board is not
existence;
(d) "Committee"
means a committee of the Boards constituted under section 13 of this Act;
(e) "Government"
means the Government of Balochistan;
(f) "Convenor"
means a Convenor of the Committee;
(g) "Council"
means the Balochistan Art Council;
(h) "Department"
means the Culture, Tourism and Archives Department Government of Balochistan;
(i) "Endowment
Fund" means the Endowment Fund established by the Council;
(j) Executive
Director" means the Executive Director of the Council; and
(k) "Chief
Minister" means the Chief Minister of Balochistan.

Incorporation

It is hereby enacted as follows:-
3. Incorporation.---(1) The Council shall be incorporated in
accordance with the provisions of this Act.
(2) The
Council shall be a body corporate having perpetual succession and a common seal
with power to acquire, hold and dispose of movable and immovable property and
may sue and be sued by the said name.

Jurisdiction of the Council

4. Jurisdiction
of the Council.---(1) Subject to
the provisions of this Act, the area of jurisdiction of the Council shall be
the whole of Balochistan.
(2) The
Council shall have its headquarter located at Quetta.
(3) The
Council shall be formed in the Directorate of Culture and shall provide all
Secretariat facilities by the Director Culture.

Functions of the Council

Balochistan Provincial Assembly.
Preamble.---Whereas, it is expedient to provide for the
establishment of the Balochistan Art Council for patronage, promotion and
development of art and craft in Balochistan and matters connected or ancillary
thereto;
It is hereby enacted as follows:-
5. Functions
of the Council.---The Council
shall -
(a) develop
and maintain facilities for all forms of art including performing arts;
(b) provide
facilities for art education and organize workshops, seminars etc.;
(c) undertake
its own productions or solicit Government or markets support through
sponsorship;
(d) institute
and confer or, as the case may be, award fellowships, scholarships, certificates,
degrees, diplomas, medals, grants, prizes, gifts, aids, loans, advances and
monetary or other benefits to individuals or groups engaged in the promotion,
study or research of various art forms;
(e) organize
art or cultural fairs, festivals and other programmes, cultural events and
exhibitions, etc., within country and abroad, on its own or in collaboration
with local and foreign bodies;
(f) print,
publish, issue books, periodicals, audio, video documentaries, films and
publications relating to art and culture;
(g) document
performers in various art forms and organizations engages in artistic
activities;
(h) establish
museums of musical instruments, sculptures, Balochistan Archives, folk
heritage, galleries, libraries including audio visual library; and
(i) implement
the provisions of the Dramatic Performances Act, 1876 (XIX of 1876), or any
other law in force relating to dramatic performances and musical programmes.

It is hereby enacted as follows:-
6. Funds.---(1) There shall be formed a fund to be known as
"The Balochistan Arts Council Fund" which shall be vested in the
council and shall be utilized by the council to meet its expenditure and
charges in connection with its functions under this Act including the payment
of salaries etc.
(2) The
funds of the council shall Comprise of-
(a) grants
from the Federal Government of Provincial Government;
(b) contributions
and donations from individuals, local governments, corporations and other
bodies;
(c) income
generated from various activities of the Council like classes, rental charges
of facilities, fees of consultancies and services, etc.;
(d) sale
proceeds of Council products; and
(e) any
other source approved by the Board.

7. Endowment
Fund Trust.---The Council shall
manage all existing endowments established by Culture department who create
from a trust to be known as the Endowment Fund Trust. The Board shall authorize
expenditure out of the capital whereas profit from investment shall be
transferred to the annual income of the Council.

8. Board
of Governors.---(1) The
management, overall control and supervision of the affairs of the Council shall
vest in a Board of Governors consisting of twelve non official members and six
ex-officio members, out of whom at least three shall be renowned cultural
activist women.
(2) Non-official
members shall be appointed by the Chief Minister for a term of three years,
reckoned from the date of appointment, from amongst those who have some
accomplishment in the field of art and interested in the promotion of art and
culture. The non-official members may be appointed for two terms only.
(3) The
Chief Minister shall be the Chief Patron of the Council;
(4) The
following shall be ex-officio members of the Board:-
(a) Secretary
to Government of Balochistan, Culture, Tourism and Archives Department;
(b) Secretary
to Government of Balochistan, Finance Department;
(c) Head
of the Fine Arts Department, University of the Balochistan, Quetta;
(d) Commissioners
of all six divisions;
(e) Six
Members of Civil Society (women) of all six divisions; and
(f) Director
Culture, Balochistan Arts Council who shall also be the Secretary of the Board.
(5) The
Minister Culture shall be the Chairperson of the Board and in his absence, the
Secretary Culture, Tourism and Archives shall act as chairperson.
(6) A
non-official member may by writing under his hand addressed to the Chairperson
resign his office. The case to fill this vacancy for the remaining tenure shall
be initiated by the Department in accordance with above subsection (2).
(7) A
non-offitial member may be removed by the Chairperson with approval of the
Chief Minister if his conduct is prejudicial to the interests of the Council or
who is guilty of grave misconduct, and a member so removed shall not be
reappointed.

9. Functions
of the Board.---The Board shall-
(a) act
as a resource and provide vision in the light of the functions of the Council
leaving the routine work to the functionaries of the Council;
(b) formulate
polices to promote art and culture;
(c) approve
budget of the Council;
(d) approve
development schemes for the Council;
(e) frame
Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for various aspects of management of the
Council such as management of endowment organization of events, operation of
its institution; and
(f) approve
financial and other cases not within the competence of the Director Culture or,
as the case may be, Chairperson.

shall meet once in three months.
(2) The
Minister shall preside over all meetings of the Board and, in his absence the
Secretary shall preside-over the meetings.

of members from Board meetings.---A
non-official member shall cease to be a member of the Board if he does not
attend three consecutive meetings of the Board unless his absence is intimated

basis of grounds of absence being satisfactory.

Chairperson and all non-official; members shall work in an honorary capacity

constitute Committees with a convenor, to which the Board may refer various
matters for examination and formulation of recommendations for consideration by
the Board. The convenor of the Committee may, with the permission of the Board,
co-opt any person whose contribution is required in such matters. The Director
Culture shall attach an officer of the Council with each Committee.
